per_distribution.policy: include package-contained SBOM for first-party wheel only after generator profile and wheel RECORD behavior are verified; not required to activate reboot phase 1
per_distribution.relationship: top-level release SBOM remains canonical release-set inventory; wheel-contained SBOM is package-local

release_sbom.coverage: all 11 first-party distribution identities plus resolved bundled/dependency components visible in exact wheel roots
release_sbom.fail_closed: every release-lock distribution must occur exactly with expected version
release_sbom.format: SPDX 2.3 JSON for initial reboot release
release_sbom.rationale: validated interoperability with existing Anchore/Syft flow and GitHub SBOM attestation; defer SPDX 3.x migration until toolchain is tested

source: scan extracted exact wheel roots, not directory of wheel archive filenames
